pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:52 /kit is the design system's documentation surface, and it is derived from its authorities (source.json, the STATUS table, the component tree) rather than hand-listed. Uncovered token groups show on the page as an error, and a live probe walks both populations with floors.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:52 Coverage of the coupling is gated, not just membership: a token group with no section is reported.
app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:43 The authority is read as data through a parser, and a failed parse is surfaced (page.tsx:51) rather than drawing an empty sheet.
app/(studio)/kit/Status.tsx:5 The status sheet is generated from the module itself, so no separate prose copy owes a same-change update.
app/(studio)/kit/Tokens.tsx:6 Tokens are drawn from the one authority instead of a hand-typed list (which the prototype kit had).
app/(studio)/kit/Tokens.tsx:9 The specimen shows the resolved value, not a picture or a copied string, so it cannot fall behind the stylesheet.
tests/live/kit.live.spec.ts:12 The live lane walks every exported component and every source token, so a missing specimen is detected rather than assumed absent.
tests/live/kit.live.spec.ts:14 There are floors (>25 components, >50 tokens, >200 text nodes), so an empty walk cannot report green.
tests/live/kit.live.spec.ts:69 The sheet's stated 'floor 12px' (sections.ts:8) is a negative claim, and it is pinned by a computed-size test.
